-- message --
slug: test titles with punctuation
-- expect --
low
-- base/internal/slug/slug.go --
package slug

import "strings"

// Make turns a title into a URL slug.
func Make(title string) string {
	return strings.ToLower(strings.Join(strings.Fields(title), "-"))
}
-- base/internal/slug/slug_test.go --
package slug

import "testing"

func TestMake(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Make("Hello World"); got != "hello-world" {
		t.Fatalf("got %q", got)
	}
}
-- head/internal/slug/slug_test.go --
package slug

import "testing"

func TestMake(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Make("Hello World"); got != "hello-world" {
		t.Fatalf("got %q", got)
	}
}

func TestMakePunctuation(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Make("Hello,  World!"); got != "hello,-world!" {
		t.Fatalf("got %q", got)
	}
}
